thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·郊义》《汉书·董仲舒传》
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过灾异祥瑞解读天意，建立天—君双向契约的政治制衡机制。天降灾异谴告君主失道，君主修省则灾异消退。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Decode Heaven's will through auspicious/inauspicious phenomena to establish a heavenly-imperial bilateral contract for political checks. Heaven sends disasters to warn of imperial failure; imperial correction leads to natural restoration.
modern_applications: 组织治理反馈修正机制

thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·深察名号》《汉书·董仲舒传》
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以《春秋》经义断狱，建立原心论罪原则。判断案件不只看行为结果，更要追溯行为动机。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Adjudicate cases using Spring and Autumn Annals principles, establishing mind-centered guilt standard. Judge by motives, not just outcomes.

thinking_modes.name_en: Three Bonds and Five Constants Method
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·基义》《春秋繁露·王道》
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 将伦理关系宇宙化本体化。以阴阳论证三纲正当性；以五行配五常，建立永恒社会伦理秩序。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Cosmologize and ontologize ethical relationships. Use yin-yang to justify Three Bonds; use five elements to map Five Constants, establishing eternal social ethical order.

thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·阳尊阴卑》《汉书·董仲舒传》
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以阴阳论证德主刑辅。阳主生配德，阴主杀配刑；阳尊阴卑决定德优先于刑。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Use yin-yang to argue virtue-dominant punishment-assistant. Yang maps to virtue; yin maps to punishment. Yang's precedence means virtue takes priority.
modern_applications: 绩效管理中激励与约束配比

thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《汉书·董仲舒传》天人三策第二策
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以大一统为宇宙法则，确立儒家为正统，通过太学五经博士制度建立意识形态再生产体系。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Take Great Unity as cosmic law, establish Confucianism as orthodoxy, build ideological reproduction through Grand Academy and Five Classics professorship system.
process: 论证大一统宇宙论基础

thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·三代改制质文》《春秋繁露·重政》
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 历史在白统、赤统、黄统三者间循环。新王必改制但不易道。改制提供合法性，守道保持连续性。
thinking_modes.definition_en: History cycles through White, Red, and Yellow Ordinances. New king must reformat but cannot change Dao. Reformatting provides legitimacy; preserving Dao maintains continuity.
modern_applications: 组织变革继承与创新平衡

thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·大一统》《汉书·董仲舒传》天人三策第三策
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 大一统是天地常经、古今通谊。通过差序格局实现有等级的统一，配合制度设计达成政治—思想—文化三位一体整合。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Great Unity is constant principle of Heaven and Earth. Achieve hierarchical unity through differential order, combined with institutional design for political-ideological-cultural integration.
process: 论证大一统宇宙论必然性
modern_applications: 多元化体系一体化协调

thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·灾异》《春秋繁露·必仁且智》
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 建立自然—政治反馈回路：君主失道→天降灾异→君主修省→灾异消退。把不可控的自然现象转化为可控的政治信号。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Establish nature-politics feedback loop: imperial failure→Heaven sends disaster→imperial reflection→disaster recedes. Transform uncontrollable natural phenomena into controllable political signals.
modern_applications: 组织危机预警系统设计
外部环境变化内部归因

thinking_modes.name_en: Three Grades of Nature Education Method
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·玉英》《春秋繁露·精华》
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 人性分三品：圣人不教而善（上智）、中民待教而善（中人）、斗筲不教而恶（下愚）。以此为依据设计分层教化体系，因材施教。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Human nature has three grades: sages are good without teaching (highest), commoners become good through teaching (middle), base people are evil without teaching (lowest). Design tiered education system accordingly.
modern_applications: 人才分层培养体系设计

thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·阴阳义》《春秋繁露·同类相动》
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以阴阳五行为通用类比框架，将自然现象、社会关系、政治制度、道德规范纳入同一解释系统。同类相动、以类合以数偶。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Use yin-yang and five elements as universal analogical framework, incorporating natural phenomena, social relations, political institutions, and moral norms into single explanatory system.
process: 建立阴阳五行分类体系
